reply: The best law I found has training NMSE about 5.5e-8, not below 1e-12, so it is close but not exact. The fitted exponents came out at eps^0.50 and T^-1.00, which supports the form: sigma ≈ −33.205 + 10.936·ln T + 4.048/T − 0.2474·T + 9.554·√eps/T − 1.470·eps.

best.code:
import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    return (params[0] + params[1]*np.log(T) + params[2]/T + params[3]*T
            + params[4]*eps**params[5]/T**params[6] + params[7]*eps)
